resources.string: Sign in to a server to configure smart downloads.
Keep the next unwatched episodes for your selected series. Specials are excluded. Downloads use app storage and appear here when complete.
Cleanup happens after watching and server synchronization. Only this feature’s local files are removed. Manual downloads and server media are untouched.
Requires valid HTTPS, a direct Wi-Fi route and the same server ID. No SSID matching or changes to VPN settings. HTTP LAN endpoints are not supported.
Allow downloads through the configured remote endpoint

Uses the signed-in server address if LAN is unavailable. Its configured transport and VPN route are retained. If disabled, downloads wait for verified LAN access. Wi-Fi and storage limits still apply.
Select series below. Series changes are saved immediately. Disabling a series keeps its existing files.
